The PSUs will vest upon the occurrence of the first of the following: (i) immediately prior to a sale event that values the company at a certain target price or more (the “Target Price”), (ii) the Company’s Initial Public Offering at a valuation of at least the Target Price, or (iii) the Company being valued on a national securities exchange at the Target Price.
